description: This file defines the LogicTransform class, which represents transformation operations applied to logic criteria in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It includes attributes for operators, number of results, and sorting, along with standard methods like getters, setters, toString, equals, and hashCode.

classes.name: LogicTransform
classes.description: Represents a transformation operation on logic criteria, such as counting results or selecting first/last results, with configurable properties for operator, number of results, and sort column.

methods.name: getTransformOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator associated with this transformation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the transformation, including operator, number of results, and sort order.

methods.name: getNumResults
methods.description: Returns the number of results to retrieve, applicable for certain operators like first and last.

methods.name: getSortColumn
methods.description: Returns the column by which results are sorted, if specified.

methods.name: setNumResults
methods.description: Sets the number of results to retrieve for this transformation.

methods.name: setSortColumn
methods.description: Sets the sort column for ordering results.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another LogicTransform object based on operator, number of results, and sort column.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code for the LogicTransform object based on its properties.
